tags_add: Sport, endurance training, coaching, workouts, physiology
notes: Coach v1.0.0 scales automatically via `depth: auto | simple | standard | pro` in `brain/coach/profile.md` (preserving any existing customized profile untouched) and tracks daily recovery/PMC load in `brain/coach/readiness.md` (`atlas.py coach note --rhr ... --sleep ...`).

Use `python -I <ROOT>/brain/_atlas/tools/atlas.py mail ingest` (add `--execute` to save) to bridge `.ics` invites and `.pdf` documents with provenance stubs into `brain/inbox/`, and `/atlas-interview` to review stale `verified:` dates and open `atlas.py conflicts`.
